name: bpoint-gift-store
description: BPoint Gift Store e-commerce backend and static storefront

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const p=require('node:path');const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const m=process.env.npm_package_json;if(!m)throw Error('npm_package_json is unavailable');console.log('Prisma install manifest: '+m);execFileSync(process.execPath,[p.join(p.dirname(m),'scripts/generate-prisma-client.js')],{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.db:migration:clients:generate: npm run db:mysql:generate && npm run db:postgres:source:generate

author: BPoint Gift Store
